Container.Name: AutoExtract
Container.Overview: Scans a folder on a schedule and automatically extracts zip, rar, 7z and tar archives (including multi-part sets and archives inside archives) into the folder they are in, then deletes the processed archives and junk files such as *.diz, or moves them to a trash folder. Web UI with live status, settings, scan history, statistics and themes. Created entirely by AI (Claude). It has been tested, but not in every situation - do your own due diligence before relying on it with data you cannot replace, and before exposing it to the internet.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, history, statistics and logs. Keep the Container Path /data.

Config.Name: Folder to scan
Config.Description: The share to scan (read/write), e.g. /mnt/user/downloads. Keep the Container Path /downloads.

Config.Name: Trash folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. /mnt/user/trash. If set, processed archives and junk are moved here instead of deleted. Must not be inside the folder to scan (or a parent of it). Keep the Container Path /trash.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the times shown in logs.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Login name for the web UI (only used when a password is set). Default admin.

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the web UI. Blank = no login.
